rules.name: exact_structural_support_pair_transfer
rules.requirement: Transfer supports as typed XY pairs with source-entity provenance and prove exact bidirectional pair-set equality; Cartesian expansion of separate X and Y sets is forbidden.
rules.rootCausePrevented: Independent X/Y expansion invents unsupported columns and beams while retaining superficially plausible axis coordinates.

rules.name: forward_annotation_occupancy_reservation
rules.requirement: Reserve final envelopes before placing annotations in the order content, axis bubbles, chain dimensions, overall dimensions and notes; every label must remain inside its owned reservation and outside every foreign reservation.
rules.rootCausePrevented: Sequential generators validate a tag only against earlier objects and then place a later dimension or note on top of it.

rules.name: dual_viewport_text_and_collision_gate
rules.requirement: At 1920x1200 and 1280x800 every required native label must be at least 8 CSS pixels high, with zero foreign-owner collision, clipping, replacement characters and horizontal overflow.
rules.rootCausePrevented: A fixed-height or text-free preview can pass static checks while labels become unreadable, overlap or disappear in the real review viewport.

rules.name: geometry_distance_semantic_pick_arbitration
rules.requirement: Choose candidates by visible-primitive screen-distance bucket, fixed semantic priority, exact distance and stable object ID; paint order is not authority and repeated picks cycle all in-scope candidates.
rules.rootCausePrevented: Wide transparent hit polygons and drawing order make intended walls unreachable or select unrelated grids and dimensions.

rules.name: document_set_scope_and_freshness
rules.requirement: Requested, rendered and source document IDs must form the same exact non-empty set; selection is document-namespaced, switching clears it, and source-to-open hashes bind the current inputs.
rules.rootCausePrevented: One stale floor can stand in for a multi-document delivery and cross-document selection can edit the wrong source.

rules.name: verified_atomic_release_closure
rules.requirement: Build in a hidden same-volume staging directory, independently validate canonical input hashes and exact manifest/SHA256 closure, then publish by verified rename with rollback; post-publication writes are forbidden.
rules.rootCausePrevented: Direct live writes mix new plans with stale views, while unlisted or later-added evidence silently breaks release closure.

rules.name: native_utf8_text_ascii_execution_separation
rules.requirement: Keep execution IDs and protocol tokens ASCII while human text remains strict UTF-8 native TEXT/MTEXT/SVG text; replacement characters and path-only text proof are forbidden.
rules.rootCausePrevented: Localized command tokens and terminal-codepage inference produce mojibake or missing labels despite successful CAD execution.
